title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (1017)
notes: 24-hour autonomous run on DeepSeek Harness (95 commits, 3,252 tool calls, 1.16B total tokens / 1.15B cached). Its best 100%-valid 25-route checkpoint (b4c0cd1, 4.0 h) scores 1.611x section-weighted (1.600x flat, 1.177x vs GCC -O2) and passes the PLAY=1 console boot smoke. At 6.0 h, unaligned CACHE 0x0d ops on sSurfacePool/sSurfaceNodePool (8f4c23b/d458094) passed all 6 public courses (where main_pool_alloc landed 16-byte aligned) but corrupted surface linked lists and hung HMC/LLL (4 private routes) on frame 0 whenever main_pool_alloc landed at 0x8 mod 16; later 6,500-unit object hibernation (5614fd4/5b5440e) broke gameplay/video/audio on 9 more private routes, and benchmark-only #ifndef PLAY audio glue edits added ~0.10x on public (reaching 1.986x console / 2.035x CPU on 6/6 public).
